MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

2. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 72

3. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 5
   D. 7

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

8. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 21
   C. 1
   D. 20

9. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 9
   C. 6
   D. 7

10. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

11. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 7

12. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 1
   C. 15
   D. 57

13. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

14. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 4

15. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 82

16. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
